name: Northwind homelab — example knowledge graph
episode_body: A small fictional homelab used to demonstrate what a Quipu knowledge graph can answer: service ownership, host topology, dependency/impact, and time-aware policy supersession. Three hosts (aurora, borealis, vault) run six services owned by three people (dana=infrastructure, evan=applications, fern=security). Deploy policy changed over time: manual deploys (2025-02-01) were superseded by GitOps deploys (2025-09-01) — a temporal 'newest-wins' pattern. No real hostnames, IPs, credentials, or people — safe to publish.
